scope: Bounded read-only current integration audit; no source/build/game/profile changes
conclusion: No demonstrated production engine compute-sizing bypass. Cannot claim every launcher/request or six tuned adaptive profiles complete; two Python request/provenance gaps remain.

consumers.status: Headless and normal/turn/replay setup share frozen resource plan and native executor count; verifier/turn invoke common Engine.beginSession.
Native map operations use owner-only central plan; absence of Python explicit intent does not bypass native CPU resolver.
Assets, preview, validation and Studio resolve phase-specific counts; explicit asset CPU/IO preserved and browser IO0; independent phases do not establish total concurrent process budget.

New game jobs get versioned execution intent by default, capability validate allocated CLI flags; result validates resolved allocation, memory provenance and actual count, measured count exact. Engine result retained and orchestration record attached separately.

actionable_gaps.problem: run_job accepts requested_execution_profile and compatibility_mode for every kind but sets execution=None for non-game generate_map. A caller supplying eco/legacy resource intent gets no forwarded intent nor validation; native MapStudy resolves context owner-only instead. Current map_generator_study uses defaults, so no demonstrated current run regression.
actionable_gaps.smallest_fix: Fail fast on unsupported explicitly supplied non-game policy arguments, or add a narrow owner-only map-generation request/receipt adapter. Do not silently discard explicit intent.
actionable_gaps.acceptance: Fix or explicitly qualify before claiming all launcher APIs support the resource request contract; not blocker for approved game-run campaign.

actionable_gaps.problem: Direct map and production-scene wrappers do not prepare an execution request/capability receipt or validate the native resolved plan; map wrappers retain implicit native owner-only context. Scene wrapper uses supported legacy aliases, not a frozen historical receipt selecting resource compatibility.
actionable_gaps.smallest_fix: Expose optional request/budget compatibility through existing native execution adapter where command supports it and persist requested/resolved provenance. For specialised renderer-only binary keep explicit non-engine scope.
actionable_gaps.acceptance: Provenance/API coverage gap, not proof that native engine skips resolver. Limit every-path claims rather than changing historical measurement defaults.

intentional_compatibility.status: Existing signed jobs with no execution field retain original command/identity; new game job default is profile aware. Explicit legacy_argv requires older CLI2; no silent fallback.

Current native benchmarks have explicit role compatibility/resource adapters and validated plan receipts. Old sealed artifacts and copied historical benchmark primitive remain deliberately unchanged; standalone shader/decoder/build/rig kernels are not game execution plans.

known_phase1_limits.limit: Intent is recognised but tier tuning/adaptive observations/hysteresis are pending; no high-end luxury/low-end eco policy proven.
Eligible logical affinity/cpuset ceiling only, no CPU-time quota/physical-core throughput discovery. Other-platform unknown allocation auto1 is explicit behaviour, not unchanged default claim.

GPU permission/capability unknown kept distinct; actual backend status/fallback must qualify device work. Render detail/resolution/preparation remain planning metadata, renderer choices are not tier guesses.

No live memory census or enforced recoverable-cache/retained-buffer budget; AssetLoader admission credits are separate from recoverable/RSS budgets. Preserve required/leased/simulation-visible caches.
Saved optional intent persists and CLI precedence works; interactive profile picker/visible reset automatic is absent. Ordinary FPS/graphics settings remain active, not a six-profile UI.
Separate mandatory owner/service roles and app-owned pools have no unified simultaneous accounting/partition yet. IO/network/audio/driver threads must not be capped with a processwide blind ceiling.

acceptance_recommendation: Accept only scoped central-plan migration with these limits; handle explicit Python intent discard before an every-path guarantee. No speculative tuning or scheduler change proposed.
